walkthroughs.body_html:
Individual Research Project — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Individual Research Project brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Individual Research Project.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which is the correct reflexive: '___ casé en 2020'?
options: me
se
te
nos

mcqs.q: When was same-sex marriage legalised in Spain?
Why does 'Me gusta el chocolate' literally translate as 'Chocolate is pleasing to me'?
options: Gustar works backwards - the thing liked is the subject, the person is the indirect object.
Gustar means 'to like' and works exactly like English.
It is a typo for 'Yo gusto'.
No veo algo.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I don't see anything' in Spanish?
options: No veo nada (double negative is correct).
No veo algo.
Veo nada.
It is a typo for 'Yo gusto'.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I travel by train' in Spanish?
options: Viajo en tren.
Viajo con tren.
Viajo por tren.
No veo algo.
